| Code | NSC402 | 
| Title | Advanced Neuroscience | 
| Credits | 3 | 
| Description | Advanced study of topics in neuroscience. The course will build upon topics covered in the Introduction to Neuroscience and focus on Neuropsychology and Neurocognition. | 
| Pre Registration Hours | 3 | 
| Prerequisites | Psychology 101, 244, and Biology 113 or 115 | 
| Corequisites | n/a | 
| Notes | n/a |
